latest.author: jason3731
latest.text: Great job! Alot of the games work perfectly on GC but I've only tried a handful for the Wii and they work pretty good except for 1 game. PUNCH-OUT!! I've tried every combination under the hood to get this game to run when a fight starts but the best I can get is between 20fps and 24fps which is not playable. Hopefully you can address the problem and release an update or patch to fix the slow framerate when a fight starts. I would love to play this game at 60fps.
